result.brief: 提出 Learned Wiring：神经元学习低维嵌入、仅邻近连接，与权重联合训练，利用组合稀疏结构提升样本效率，并在世界模型预测任务上验证。
result.reason: Learned sparse wiring for sample-efficient prediction; evaluated on 17 world-model prediction tasks, but contribution is generic network architecture, not video/multimodal world modeling or visual representation learning.
